run_pretrained_model_evaluation: run the test_pretrained script to evaluate a pre-trained Demucs model on the MusDB dataset
run_evaluation_with_overrides: run the test_pretrained script with custom overrides like test.shifts=2 to evaluate a model
run_sdr_evaluation: run the test_pretrained script to compute SDR metrics for a pre-trained Demucs model
run_model_bag_evaluation: run the test_pretrained script to evaluate a bag of pre-trained Demucs models on MusDB
run_evaluation_with_model_flags: run the test_pretrained script with pretrained model flags to evaluate a specific Demucs checkpoint
